entity.name: Get Talky Inc.
entity.description: Get Talky Inc. is a small, founder-owned software company in New York City (Delaware C corporation, founded November 2024). It owns and maintains OpenVPM, a free, AGPL-3.0 licensed veterinary practice management system. OpenVPM is developed in the open by Get Talky staff and outside contributors; self-hosting is free and unrestricted, and an optional hosted service (OpenVPM Cloud) helps sustain development. OpenVPM has received no grants, donations or sponsorships to date.

projects.name: OpenVPM
projects.description: OpenVPM is a free, open-source, API-first veterinary practice management system (PIMS). Clinics use it for client and patient records, scheduling, medical records (SOAP notes, vaccinations, prescriptions, lab results), append-only controlled-substance logs, billing, inventory, reminders and a client portal. It ships a versioned REST API with scoped keys and HMAC-signed webhooks, an optional AI agent with explicit opt-in for every write, and multi-tenant isolation enforced by PostgreSQL row-level security. Clinics can self-host it with Docker Compose. Veterinary software is dominated by closed, expensive vendors; OpenVPM gives small clinics with no IT staff an open, secure system of record they control.

plans.name: OpenVPM maintenance: i18n, migrations and security
plans.description: About 12 months of maintainer time on work no paying customer funds: (1) i18n: implement the agreed architecture (docs/I18N.md), message catalogs and community translations; (2) migrations: extend the dry-run CSV import with more record types and adapters for common legacy practice-management exports; (3) security: CodeQL, OpenSSF Scorecard, private vulnerability reporting, signed releases with SBOMs and provenance, a threat model, and an external review of row-level-security tenancy.
